contract: Compare every sample of both the full inverse MDCT and DCT-IV with the independent float64 cosine definitions and the documented projection of the public av_tx inverse float MDCT.
Every supported output length through 8192 uses scales 1 and 1/N, one seeded coefficient vector and first and last impulses. Follow the imdct_float numeric rule.
A length refused by av_tx is compared with the cosine definitions. Reference discrepancies are kept as open cases and never waive the definition comparison.
pending_module_requirements: The public av_tx output differs from the cosine definition at these AArch64 lengths. The independent definition comparison remains required.
